dedupe_keys.name: nist o ran module for ns 3

description: The NIST O-RAN module adds radio-access-network controller models to ns-3. It represents a near-real-time RAN Intelligent Controller, reporting endpoints, configurable logic modules and conflict mitigation, with SQLite storage for reports, commands and logs. Users define network nodes, reporting and controller logic; outputs include handover behaviour, packet-related observations and controller records. Coverage is globally configurable at simulated network scale, with timing determined by the ns-3 scenario. NIST source is free under its public-service software notice, requiring preservation of the notice and acknowledgement, while dependencies retain separate licences. A limitation is that the package models selected O-RAN behaviour, not complete protocol conformance, and supplied machine-learning handover models are explicitly demonstrations. The reviewed requirements include ns-3.42 and SQLite, with optional ONNX or PyTorch support. It supports telecom-control simulations on ns-3 (platform-ns-3). The README provides examples and a 2023 Workshop on ns-3 paper, and labels maintenance best-effort after feature completion. No network simulation or model weights were executed or downloaded.
